messages.content: hi, pico. i have a little time to talk.
hello. what would you like to talk about?
my garden. i have a new flower.
what does the flower look like?
i made rice for lunch and had it with my sister.
did you both enjoy it?
yes. we had soup with it too.
you had rice and soup together.
tell my friend i am cooking and will answer later.
i am cooking now. i will answer later.
keep it one sentence.
i am cooking now, so i will answer later.
ask in a kind way if i can sit with my friend. use would you mind.
would you mind if i sat here with you?
now make it about my sister sitting with us.
would you mind if my sister sat with us?
i have washed the cups. now i want to read.
you finished the cups, so you can choose reading next.
write a short sentence about that.
i have washed the cups, and now i will read.
the book that i want is on the top shelf. where should i look?
on the top shelf.
is that the bottom shelf?
no. you said the top shelf.
my father visited my grandfather yesterday.
did they have a nice time together?
yes. they talked in the garden.
they talked in the garden together.
ask my cousin if she often reads after dinner.
do you often read after dinner?
do not say every day.
do you often read after dinner?
say i cannot come because i have to work.
i cannot come because i have to work.
make it kind with sorry.
sorry, i cannot come because i have to work.
change the boy walked home to now, with is.
the boy is walking home.
is he already home in that sentence?
no. he is still walking home.
ask my sister if we can read together after lunch.
can we read together after lunch?
now ask about before lunch.
can we read together before lunch?
write that the door was fixed by my uncle.
the door was fixed by my uncle.
now put my uncle first.
my uncle fixed the door.
i was going to visit my friend, but she could not meet today.
you can feel sad when you want to see a friend and cannot.
yes. we will talk on the phone instead.
you can still have some time to talk that way.
if i have time after work, i will go for a walk.
the walk is your plan if you have time after work.
does that say i will go for sure?
no. it keeps if i have time in the plan.
i read the first page, then the last page. which did i read first?
the first page.
what came after it in what i said?
the last page.
ask my friend if she has my pencil.
do you have my pencil?
use book instead of pencil.
do you have my book?
i will visit my aunt with my brother. write it with we.
we will visit our aunt.
keep tomorrow in it too.
we will visit our aunt tomorrow.
i have found my keys at last.
where were they?
in the little bag by the door.
you found them in the little bag by the door.
ask why my brother is waiting outside.
why are you waiting outside?
now ask where he is waiting instead.
where are you waiting?
i was making tea when someone called my phone.
did you stop to answer it?
yes. it was my mother calling.
you talked to your mother instead of making tea.
write that all my books are on the shelf.
all my books are on the shelf.
now say some instead of all.
some of my books are on the shelf.
i never drink coffee. does that mean i drink it sometimes?
no. never says you do not drink it at any time.
now write that i sometimes drink tea.
i sometimes drink tea.
i have a red cup and a blue cup. i want the blue one.
the blue cup is the one you want.
what color is the other one?
red.
ask if i will have finished my work before lunch.
will i have finished my work before lunch?
do you know the answer?
no. you have not said how much work or time you have.
i have been trying to write a letter all morning.
what part is hard to write?
the end. i want to thank my teacher.
you could end with: thank you for helping me learn.
my bag and the bag my sister has are the same size. say it with as big as.
my bag is as big as the bag my sister has.
does that say my bag is big and the other is small?
no. it says they are the same size.
put before first in i will wash my hands before i eat.
before i eat, i will wash my hands.
did washing still come first?
yes.
use almost in a sentence about finishing a book.
i have almost finished my book.
does almost mean it is all done?
no. there is still some left to finish.
she had left before i came. who was there first?
she was there before you came, then she left.
did we meet in that sentence?
no. she left before you came.
ask am i going the right way.
am i going the right way?
now ask about we.
are we going the right way?
i am free this afternoon, and i would like to stay home.
you have free time and want to spend it at home.
do not give me a trip plan.
okay. you can choose a quiet afternoon at home.
write that my sister asked where my bag was.
my sister asked where my bag was.
now write the question from her to me.
where is your bag?
my brother would like rice and i would like it too. write that in a simple way.
my brother and i both like rice.
does too mean i like another food instead?
no. here it says you like rice as your brother does.
i have not visited my aunt this year.
would you like help writing to her?
yes. ask if i can come next year.
could i visit you next year?
tell my friend i might be home in the evening.
i might be home in the evening.
does might say i am sure?
no. it says you are not sure.
write that i am still waiting for my sister.
i am still waiting for my sister.
does that say she has already come?
no. you are still waiting.
write please bring my book.
please bring my book.
now put please at the end.
bring my book, please.
answer no to did you go to the park. say all the words.
no, i did not go to the park.
is that true about you or just my example?
it is the example answer you asked me to write.
the window was opened. do you know who opened it?
no. that sentence does not say who did it.
now add that my father opened it.
the window was opened by my father.
i wrote if my aunt comes, we will have tea. keep if because i am not sure she will come.
if my aunt comes, we will have tea.
now she says she is coming. use when.
when my aunt comes, we will have tea.
use had been in a sentence about a quiet room.
the room had been quiet before the children came.
does it say why the children came?
no. the sentence does not give their reason.
ask my father what he is doing.
what are you doing?
now ask what he was doing yesterday.
what were you doing yesterday?
write a sentence starting with reading.
reading helps me learn.
now use walking instead.
walking helps me feel calm.
write that i have my own room.
i have my own room.
does own mean the room of my sister?
no. here it says it is your room.
i finished the book i started last year.
you have finished the book you started last year.
yes. i am happy about that.
it is nice to finish a thing you want to do.
ask my friend if she will come after lunch.
will you come after lunch?
now ask if she will come before lunch.
will you come before lunch?
i am cold. i will put on my coat. join them with so.
i am cold, so i will put on my coat.
did you change the reason?
no. being cold is still the reason.
say i must return the book today with have to.
i have to return the book today.
does that mean i already gave it back?
no. it says you need to return it today.
ask which of the two bags is my bag.
which of these two bags is my bag?
now make it a question to my sister about her bag.
which of these two bags is your bag?
thank you for the help. i will try writing it now.
you are welcome.
can we stop here for now?
yes. we can stop here.
